subject: Life Skills
title: The Power of Silence
description: A 60-second lesson on The Power of Silence.

hook.text: Negotiators use silence as a weapon. After making an offer, they stop talking. The other side fills the gap.

buildup.text: Silence creates social pressure. Most people rush to fill it, often revealing more than they planned to share.

discovery.text: In therapy, a well-timed pause after a question often pulls out deeper answers than any follow-up question could.

twist.text: Silence is uncomfortable for the user too. The skill is learning to sit in it without flinching or rescuing the moment.

climax.text: Try it: ask a meaningful question and then wait. Count to five silently.

punchline.text: Say less. Hear more. Silence does the heavy lifting.

quiz.question: Why does silence often produce deeper answers?
options: People feel pressured to fill the gap with more honest responses
It signals that you are a good listener
